question: What are Shion and Lilac's favorite foods?
answer:
I think Shion and Lilac probably have the same favorite foods.

There were illustrations of them at a hot spring carrying alcohol, so when I think of hot springs and alcohol... how about onsen manju?

They also seem to like sweet things, so I'll confirm that with the writer of Re:Zero - Lost in Memories - just to be sure. (laughs)
